reels.title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning

editorial_notes.reasoning: This aligns with the high-velocity robotics_tamp category (1.28x) and offers a fascinating 'missing sense' angle. Animating human touch data being mapped to robot movement provides high-quality visual potential for a 3b1b style video.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why are robots still failing to pick up a delicate wine glass, even after seeing millions of videos of people doing it?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Learning to walk in the dark; just as you use your hands to map a room without seeing it, TouchScale gives robots the 'pressure-map' of the world.
